summary: Rewrote backend_test.py for the new account-based API and executed full end-to-end frontend flow via Playwright. All 16 backend tests pass. All frontend flows pass: single-login auto-detects role, admin/user redirects, launcher with settings+phone icons, admin account CRUD, admin device edits, admin password reset, user self-edit via /edit persists to /about and /phone *#06# IMEI sheet (coverage-qr + IMEI visible), session persists across reload, role guards work (user->/apps, admin->/admin). Final DB state verified: exactly 1 account 'user1' with IMEI 356789104532198 and device_name 'iPhone'.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is ~360 lines - acceptable, but DEFAULT_DEVICE constant + models could be split into a models.py module for maintainability.
JWT tokens have no expiration by product requirement (session must not expire); if this is not intentional forever, consider a long-lived refresh token pattern instead of tokenless-exp.
verify_password / hash_password are synchronous CPU-bound; under load, consider offloading via run_in_executor to avoid blocking the event loop.
GET /api/me/device and PUT /api/me/device use decode_token + get_current_user manually instead of Depends(get_current_user); minor inconsistency vs admin routes.
seed_data_creation: Test flow creates & deletes 'budi' account; final state confirmed as exactly 1 account 'user1' with default IMEI 356789104532198 and device_name 'iPhone'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py includes a session-scoped autouse fixture (_reset_db_state) that cleans DB (deletes non-user1 accounts and resets user1 device to defaults) before tests run — this makes tests re-runnable. pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; do not modify. barcode-imei is an SVG element so use text_content(), not inner_text(); IMEI value is present in the imei-info-sheet text content.
